Synthetic example data

Source: R/example.R
ntl_example.Rd

Writes a small, entirely synthetic nighttime lights dataset in EOG monthly file format and returns matching vector data, so examples, tests and the vignette run offline in seconds. None of it is real data.

Usage

ntl_example(dir = file.path(tempdir(), "ntlpanel-example"), overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

dir

Directory to write the GeoTIFFs to.

overwrite

Rewrite files that already exist.

Value

A list with dir (path), units_old (six districts, column district), units_new (a later vintage, column district_new, in which D1 is split into D1a/D1b and D5 and D6 merge into D56) and sites (two dated treatment sites, columns site and start).

Details

The area is a 6 x 6 degree box (66-72 E, 46-52 N) at 0.05 degree resolution, with:

  • two cities with steady growth and a winter brightening;

  • two "treatment" sites that switch on in June 2022 and March 2023;

  • a summer stray-light blackout north of 49 N in June and July (zero coverage, stored as 0 radiance as in EOG files) and thin coverage in May and August;

  • a Suomi NPP series (npp, 2021-01 to 2023-12) and a NOAA-20 series (j01, 2022-07 to 2023-12) that reads about 8% brighter.

Examples

ex <- ntl_example()
ex$units_old
#> Simple feature collection with 6 features and 1 field
#> Geometry type: POLYGON
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 66 ymin: 46 xmax: 72 ymax: 52
#> Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
#>   district                       geometry
#> 1       D1 POLYGON ((66 49, 68 49, 68 ...
#> 2       D2 POLYGON ((68 49, 70 49, 70 ...
#> 3       D3 POLYGON ((70 49, 72 49, 72 ...
#> 4       D4 POLYGON ((66 46, 68 46, 68 ...
#> 5       D5 POLYGON ((68 46, 70 46, 70 ...
#> 6       D6 POLYGON ((70 46, 72 46, 72 ...
length(list.files(ex$dir))
#> [1] 108
